consumptionData.methodology: ADAC records manufacturer stated WLTP phase values for a current Golf 2.0 TDI Energy variant. Those values are mapped to RouteCost categories: WLTP short trip to urban, WLTP country road to interurban, WLTP motorway to motorway, and WLTP combined to unknown.

sources.title: VW Golf 2.0 TDI ENERGY (06/25 - 09/25)
sources.notes: Used for current Golf VIII facelift 2.0 TDI variant, 1968 cc displacement, and manufacturer stated WLTP consumption values.
